No declaration states Proposition 4.10, and the repository never cites it. The Lean builds one joined profile on all X ≥ 0. exists_ordered_nominal_witness gives the paper's order of choices for every C ≥ C0, so it covers (i) and (iii): smoothness, the moment match at e^{-5} and the shared Π0. The cone clauses of (ii) come only from exists_certificate, for one internally chosen C. The skeptics found better pairings. (4.33) is stated for W's own T0, through nominal_activation_stress, activation_direction_positive and the EdgeFactor bounds. T0 = 0 holds on the closed interval up to X_a. The real residual gaps are: no cone for every C ≥ C0, no analyticity statement for W, and the exact leading coefficient B_a(0) with order 0 unstated. The verdict is DELTA with relation partial.

findings.summary: No single declaration states Proposition 4.10. The cone certificate's only existence theorems give one W (NominalConeAssembly.exists_certificate), built at Λ = Λ0, C = C0. Its ingredients are stated for every C ≥ C0 and any radius floor (MatchingConeBounds.exists_ordered_prepared_continuation); the uniform certificate is not stated.

The auditor said (4.33) appears only for an upstream activated stress and that the bounds are unstated. In fact W's own T0 equals activationStress W on the first collar, which has an EdgeFactor with c = t1², and generic lemmas give both bounds.

In Lean's (4.33), the leading coefficient at y=0 is fixed only by a positive first component and a direction. The paper's B_a(0,η)=F(X_a,η)𝔰(X_a,η) is not stated, and the 1/y^order prefactor's order is hidden by an existential, so smooth g_a with g_a(0)>0 is not literal.

No declaration states η-analyticity of the matched profile's fields (f, U, Π, V0/X and their radial derivatives) on one complex neighbourhood over [0, X_an]. Witness and Certificate have no analyticity clause.

The auditor said T0 = 0 is stated only for X ≤ X_a/2. That is wrong. For the nominal Witness, T0 = 0 on (0, X_a] (closed), at X = 0 by formula, and on [0, X_a] for the final witness. (4.13) holds on (0, X_a), and the endpoint follows by continuity.

The ordered choice (j, then Λ, then T_sh and C0, then every C ≥ C0) and the closing sentence (X_R → ∞ with Λ and T_sh fixed) are stated for the full matched Witness. The auditor omitted this and called large_nominal the closest.
